Hi Ellen — great to hear the timeline. Looping in Dev (implementation lead) and Marissa (CS handoff) so we can align the operational pieces. Summary of proposed approach below: 

1) Projects & Keys
- We'll create three logical projects in your tenant: brightcare-sandbox, brightcare-staging, brightcare-prod.
- Dev will provision scoped API keys per project. Sandbox keys default to token quotas and a testing model; staging keys mirror prod limits but with throttling; prod keys are on your Dedicated instance or hosted prod profile depending on which you chose in procurement.
- Keys will be issued as "primary" (server-side, long-lived) and "ephemeral" (short-lived, for front-end/mobile). We recommend introducing ephemeral keys for any client-side usage.

2) Roles & Access
- We'll send our current roles matrix (roles: Org Admin, Project Admin, Developer, ReadOnly, Billing) for you to map to internal groups. Marissa, attaching the roles doc now.

3) SSO/SCIM
- SSO is optional for initial sandbox. For pilot/prod we recommend SSO + SCIM for user provisioning. That typically takes 5-7 business days to configure once we receive SAML metadata.

Next steps (short):
- Ellen: confirm project names and list of initial admins per project
- BrightCare IT: send SAML metadata when ready
- Dev (cc): provision sandbox keys and post them to the secure vault; share rotation policy

I'll schedule a 30-min handoff tomorrow to lock these choices.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
